title: Invitation-based Author Registration Flow
description: Verify that new authors can register only via valid invitation links and complete secure account registration.

steps.description: Receive a valid invitation email with registration link
Navigate to registration page using invitation link
Fill in email, password, and required fields
Submit registration form
Verify account created and user is logged in automatically
Attempt registration without invitation link
Verify registration is denied without valid invitation

title: Authentication with Email/Password, Social Login, and Web3 Wallet
description: Verify login functionality works correctly for all supported authentication methods including email/password, social providers, and Web3 wallet with secure session handling.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Attempt login with valid email and password
Confirm successful login and access to protected areas
Attempt login with invalid email/password
Verify login failure with appropriate error message
Login via supported social provider (e.g., Google or Facebook)
Verify successful authentication and session creation
Login via Web3 wallet connection after authentication
Verify wallet connection is established securely and token balance is displayed

title: Article Creation with Rich Text and Media Support
description: Validate that authors can create, save drafts, edit, and publish multi-format articles supporting rich text, embedded videos, debates, and storyboard episodic content with version tracking.

steps.description: Login as an invited author
Navigate to new article creation page
Input rich text content with formatting
Embed a YouTube video and validate display
Switch article type to debate and add voting options
Create storyboard series with episodic navigation
Save article as draft
Verify draft is saved with version tracking
Submit article for moderation
Verify article enters moderation queue
After approval, verify article is published and visible to readers

title: Threaded Commenting with Moderation and Community Flagging
description: Ensure that users can post threaded comments with replies, like comments, flag inappropriate content, and that moderators can manage flagged content effectively.

steps.description: Navigate to an article's comment section
Post a root-level comment
Comment is immediately visible with correct user attribution
Reply to existing comment to form a thread
Reply appears nested under parent comment
Like a comment
Like count increments accordingly
Flag a comment as inappropriate
Flagged comment is queued for moderator review and user receives confirmation
Moderator reviews flagged comments in moderation queue
Moderator can approve, delete, or escalate the comment

title: Debate Article Voting with Real-time Results
description: Test that readers can vote on debate articles, votes update in real time with correct counting, and results visualization is accurate.

steps.description: Navigate to a published debate article
Cast a vote on one of the debate options
Vote is registered and total votes update in real time
Attempt to vote multiple times from the same user
System prevents duplicate voting from same user
Visualize voting results graphically
Graphs accurately reflect current vote distribution

title: Content Moderation Workflow Including Automated Screening and Human Review
description: Verify that articles and comments undergo automated content screening, are flagged appropriately, and that moderators can perform human review before publishing or rejecting content.

steps.description: Submit article or comment containing borderline or suspicious content
Automated screening flags content and places it in moderation queue
Access moderation queue as moderator
Flagged content is listed with relevant details for review
Reject content with reason
Content is not published and author is notified
Approve safe content
Content status updates to published and appears live

title: Reward Token Dispensing Upon User Engagement
description: Confirm that users receive cryptocurrency rewards accurately for designated engagement activities such as reading, commenting, and voting, and tokens are credited to Web3 wallet correctly via Thirdweb SDK.

steps.description: Authenticate user and connect crypto wallet
Perform engagement activity such as reading a full article
Reward token transaction is initiated and confirmed
Check wallet balance updates reflecting earned tokens
Perform comment posting and vote actions
Corresponding token rewards are successfully dispensed with 99%+ transaction success rate

title: Media Upload with Image Optimization and CDN Delivery
description: Verify media files upload process including progress display, image optimization is performed properly, and delivered via CDN with acceptable load times.

steps.description: Navigate to media upload interface as content creator
Upload various media files including images and videos
Uploads complete successfully with progress indication
Images are optimized (resized/compressed) automatically
Access uploaded media content from multiple devices
Media is delivered via CDN, with load times meeting performance targets

title: Form Validation using React Hook Form and Zod Schema Enforcement
description: Ensure all user input forms including registration, article creation, comments, and profile update enforce validation rules strictly, handle errors gracefully, and sanitize inputs to prevent XSS.

steps.description: Open registration and login forms
Input invalid emails, passwords, and missing required fields
Form validation errors are displayed with user-friendly messages
Attempt article submission with invalid or malicious inputs (e.g. scripts)
Submission is rejected or sanitized, warnings shown if needed
Submit comments containing HTML tags and scripts
Input is sanitized to prevent XSS attacks

title: User Profile Display and Privacy Settings
description: Verify user profiles display reading stats, achievements, and activity accurately while respecting configured privacy settings for different user roles.

steps.description: Login and navigate to own profile page
Personal reading analytics, badges, and achievements are visible and correct
Update privacy settings to restrict public access
View profile as another user or anonymous
Private information is hidden as per settings

title: Admin Portal User and Content Management
description: Test admin abilities to manage users, moderate content, review analytics dashboards, and audit actions with role-based permissions enforced.

steps.description: Login as admin user
Access user management interface
Modify user roles, deactivate/reactivate accounts
Changes persist and permissions update accordingly
Access moderation queues
Pending flagged content is listed with actionable options
View analytics dashboards for user engagement and platform health
Metrics reflect real-time accurate data

title: Performance and Scalability Testing Under Load
description: Validate platform maintains fast page loads, low error rates, and scalability handling with concurrent users according to performance benchmarks.

steps.description: Simulate multiple concurrent user sessions (readers, authors, moderators)
Page load times remain under defined threshold (e.g., <2 seconds)
Error rates remain below target (e.g., <1%) during peak usage
Monitor system resource usage and response time metrics
Scalability targets are met without degradation

title: Compliance Verification for COPPA and GDPR Privacy Regulations
description: Ensure platform prompts for parental consent, manages data privacy options appropriately, and provides mechanisms for data access, correction, and deletion in compliance with COPPA and GDPR.

steps.description: Attempt registration as a child user under age 13
System requests verified parental consent before account creation
Request user data export and deletion from profile settings
User receives requested data in a structured format and account is deleted on request
Verify data collection and consent logs maintained for audit
Logs comply with privacy law requirements

title: Security and Input Sanitization Against XSS and Injection Attacks
description: Validate all user inputs are sanitized, scripts are blocked or escaped, and token-based security prevents unauthorized access or manipulation.

steps.description: Input scripts, HTML tags, and SQL injection attempts in all user-accessible forms
Inputs are sanitized and malicious payloads are neutralized
Attempt unauthorized actions using manipulated tokens or headers
Security system rejects unauthorized requests with appropriate error messages

title: Email Invitation and Notification System via Resend API
description: Verify email communications are sent correctly through Resend API, including invitation mails, approval notifications, and account related emails with appropriate content and delivery status.

steps.description: Trigger an invitation email from admin portal
Invitation email is received with proper link and content
Approve an article triggering notification email
Author receives publication notification email
Send password reset or other user notifications
Emails are delivered without delay and formatted correctly

title: Leaderboard and Achievement Badge System Accuracy
description: Validate that user achievements such as badges and reading streaks update correctly upon qualifying activities and leaderboards reflect real-time rankings accurately.

steps.description: Perform activities qualifying for achievements (e.g., multiple articles read, comments posted)
User badges and reading streak counts update correctly
View leaderboard rankings before and after activity
Leaderboard updates to reflect new rankings in real time

title: Navigation and Category Filtering Functionality
description: Test that the responsive navigation menu, category filters, and breadcrumbs work correctly across devices and allow users to find articles efficiently.

steps.description: Load homepage on desktop and mobile
Navigation menu adapts responsively
Use category filters to select different article topics
Articles list updates correctly to match selected categories
Use breadcrumb links to navigate back to higher-level pages
Navigations behave as expected throughout the site

title: Error Boundary Handling and Recovery
description: Simulate runtime errors in various components to verify the error boundary catches exceptions gracefully and displays user-friendly fallback UI with options to recover or report issues.

steps.description: Introduce a fatal error in React component (e.g., article content rendering)
Error boundary catches error and fallback UI renders
Trigger error in admin interface
Admin error boundary handles error and allows recovery
Attempt user recovery options, e.g., reload or navigate away
User can recover from error without page crash
